meta.format: ENGINE_SPEC v1, machine-oriented JSON for an LLM reader; concept_model explains the engine, the rest specifies it
meta.staleness: authoritative only at git_commit; regenerate after any engine change

concept_model.one_line: VAE V22 looks at a photographed sumi-ink painting the way a trained critic would, but with measurement doing everything measurement can: Python measures the sheet, a model judges only what cannot be measured, independent model readings are voted (two, plus a third only to break a split), and code turns the settled judgments into a 1-10 rating.
concept_model.audience_note: this spec serves two uses: explaining the VAE to others (read concept_model first) and operating/maintaining it (everything after)
problem: Peter Yuill paints large abstract sumi-ink works (mega-brushes, Chinese papers, ~97x180 cm), a year-long Crucible Year practice of 368+ numbered works T_001..
he wants an accurate, trackable 1-10 rating per work, comparable across the year, to see what improved and how

previous engines (V7/V10/V10C) felt 'only slightly better than a guess'; they rewarded heavy, textured, layered material load, which is Peter's baseline, not his quality: T_323 (Peter 5) scored 9 and T_326 (Peter 6) scored 10
a first V22 attempt decomposed judgment into a 14-step, per-cell evidence cascade; two blind reads of the same paintings disagreed on 30-70% of axes, so finer decomposition did not buy reliability
approach: measure first: deterministic Python on the 16-bit TIFF master measures every property that can be measured (ink masses, edges, overlaps, stroke paths, weight, unpainted voids, stroke orientation, edge contact, presence) and hands those to the model as facts that outrank its own reading
judge lean: the model answers one categorical question per axis, choosing a rung on a fixed five-rung ladder, writing its observation before its choice and naming what fails the next rung up
buy consistency by ensembling: the same lean call is run three times independently and voted; disagreement is reported as unresolved, never averaged

make rarity structural: the top rung ('master') means the excellent quality held everywhere without exception plus one further property, proven by a complete survey, and it only survives if every run independently awards it with high confidence; Python checks the survey against the measurements
keep the number out of the model: the model never sees a score; code computes the rating from the settled rungs with weights Peter can read and change
how_it_works: Step 1 (Python, zero model calls): from the TIFF, find ink (darkest 5 of 9 tonal bands), split it into elements, splatter and residue; profile every edge (crisp, soft, broken, bloom-like); find cells where passes overlap and how many tonal bands they hold; trace each stroke's path, width and endpoints; count masses and weight displacement; find held voids (paper with ink on opposite sides) and how crisp their limits are; read the main and second stroke orientation families (axial, so they locate directions without saying which way a mark travelled); record where ink meets each sheet edge and where weight sits against the sheet's centre, centre lines and edge midpoints; measure presence (ink coverage, share of the sheet in the two darkest tones, deepest ink against paper, edge-kind mix)
Step 1 output is validated against Peter's eye via colour overlays, never against a model

Step 2 (model): one prompt per painting carries the measured facts in plain cell-named English plus five views of the sheet (the photograph, a greyscale with a red 6x3 grid, a hand-picked close-up crop, an inverted view showing unpainted paper as shape, a low-pass view showing weight); the model names the sheet's parts, then classifies 14 axes

Step 2 (code): validate each run's JSON under its schema version and check it agrees with itself (a self-contradicting axis loses only its vote), cap any rung-4 claim whose survey contradicts a measurement, vote the runs per axis (run 3 only as a tie-break on axes runs 1 and 2 split), apply the master gate, compute the rating with its coverage and bounds
Step 3 (model, later): turns the settled findings into readable critical prose in four sections plus a free response ('NEON'), forbidden to change any finding

axes_plain.A1: Material Control: did the ink's behaviour on this paper stay governed; rare = a material behaviour (a halted bleed, a contained bloom) doing structural work where loss was likeliest
axes_plain.A2: Edge Command: do edge kinds vary with structural role; rare = an edge alone carries a relationship (a crisp shared edge locks ink and void)
axes_plain.A3: Stroke Conviction: do principal strokes read as committed continuous acts; rare = a full-length stroke with the marks of speed on it that stays sound in every phase; NOT_PRESENT when no stroke can be judged as an act
axes_plain.B1: Layer Architecture: do overlapping passes stay distinct with consistent depth; rare = the darkest register confined to structural positions
axes_plain.B2: Resolution: did the sheet stop where its structure was complete (no clutter in voids, unresolved ends, filling, retrace); rare = every part costs something if removed
axes_plain.C1: Void: is unpainted paper a shaped, load-bearing part of the structure; rare = void and ink lock at shared junctions with findable limits (crisp or soft) and the void reads as a shape in its own right
axes_plain.C2: Equilibrium: how the weight is handled, displaced or centred; rare = balance held by opposing forces (two movements, or a movement and a void), not mass alone
axes_plain.C3: Directional Structure: what organises movement; rare = two opposing movements unified by a shared centre, void or axis, or one full-length movement every other part takes its direction from
axes_plain.C4: Frame Engagement: how the structure meets the four edges; rare = three or more edges each doing a different named job, or composed margins around a contained structure, with the structure placed against the sheet
axes_plain.C5: Load-Bearing Parts: do parts beyond the primary carry load nothing else could; rare = removing a part changes a property of the primary itself
axes_plain.D1: Chance Integration: what the painting did with chance events (bloom, splatter, drip); rare = the event is built into the structure by a named visible route and the passage's structure depends on it (judged on what the sheet shows, not how it came about)
axes_plain.D2: Visual Cadence: where a unit repeats, does the sequence do something; rare = a deliberate break in the sequence that the structure uses
axes_plain.D3: Risk: how difficult was what the sheet attempted, and did it hold; rare = two or more high-difficulty acts hold and the sheet's principal relation depends on both; on watch (Peter 2026-09-24): the calibration report tests whether it adds anything beyond A1/A3/C1/C3
axes_plain.E1: Presence: does the sheet register with force at viewing distance (added v2.1 after T_188); not coverage: one decisive dark stroke on open paper can command a sheet, pale blurred wash can barely register; rare = the darkest ink meets the brightest paper at a structural junction or void, so force and structure are one event

rung_meaning.0: structural failure (in a structural position, recurring, or dominating the sheet): occasional
rung_meaning.2: strong: a named quality clearly achieved: common
rung_meaning.3: excellent: the quality in a compound demanding form: occasional
rung_meaning.4: master: rung 3 held everywhere without exception plus a further property: rare

concept_model.rating: weighted mean rung (0-4) mapped through anchors 0->1, 1->5, 2->7, 3->9, 4->10, joined linearly, so the whole 1-10 scale is reachable (the ends are fixed; calibration moves the interior anchors); pre-calibration weights: E1 x3, structural C1-C4 x2, A2 A3 B2 C5 D1 x1, A1 B1 D2 D3 x0.5; unresolved applicable axes are reported as weight coverage plus a low/high rating range, and a result is provisional below 80% coverage or with a weight-2+ axis unsettled
what_failed_before: V21.5-derived ladders on a 10-painting run: floor rungs fired on single instances (PHASE_FAILURE 7/10, WORKED_PAST_REPEATEDLY 7/10), top rungs passed easily (5/10), some axes never discriminated (COHERENT 9/10), two axes never produced a value
the model's own read of how many ink masses a sheet has disagreed with itself on 4 of 10 paintings across sessions, whatever facts it was given: gestalt judgments are volatile, so V22 measures them
evidence_so_far: hand-check of six Peter-rated works against the new ladders (not a model run): the structural axes C1-C4 separate Peter's 9s (T_333, T_338, T_317) from his 5s and 6s (T_326, T_323, T_327) the way he did, while material/layer axes A1/B1 do not: layering is his baseline
what his 9s have and his 5s lack: a held, clean, load-bearing void; opposing movements unified; balance carried by direction; structure placed against the sheet's edges

Step 1 overlays checked on T_128, T_313, T_323, T_326, T_328: voids, movements and edge contact read correctly except large voids beyond ~40% of the short side (T_326's arc interior) which are not measured

first model runs (Opus 5.5, v2): T_316 engine 6.9 vs Peter 7 and T_328 7.9 vs Peter 9, both accepted final; runs 1 and 2 agreed on 10 of 13 axes each time (the archived granular prompt disagreed on 30-70%)

T_188 engine 7.3 vs Peter's blind 3-4: the first clear miss; the engine had no measure of whether a sheet registers at all, rule 7 let fragments carry axes, the bleed never met the rung-0 bar; v2.1 is the response

presence across the 20 rated measured works: darkest-tone share tracks Peter's rating best (Spearman 0.49), coverage barely (0.17), soft edges weakly against (-0.23); T_313 (Peter 9) is sparse (34% coverage), so presence is defined as force, not coverage
a Sonnet 5 check on T_316 was consistent (12 of 13 axes agree) at about 0.6 of the cost but leaned one rung high on six axes; Opus 5.5 stays the engine model

T_188 on v2.1 (two runs): 7.8 provisional; the runs agree with each other (11 of 14 axes) but award rungs for one qualifying local feature and never weigh how much of the sheet works; E1 went to ARRESTING on a single junction while the sheet's deepest ink (0.15) is the palest of 21 measured rated works. Conclusion (Peter): the ladders' qualifications are too lenient
accuracy is unproven until the 16-work calibration set is run and reported

glossary.cell: one of 18 grid cells, A1-F3 landscape or A1-C6 portrait
glossary.element: connected ink region long enough to be structural (Step 1)
glossary.part: the model's structural unit (P1.. ink, V1.. void); may be one element, several, or a region of one
glossary.held void: unpainted paper with ink on two opposite sides
glossary.pass: one application of ink; passes overlap to build tone
glossary.feibai / dry brush: gaps parallel to the stroke's travel
glossary.rung: one of five ordered values on an axis ladder (0-4)
glossary.master gate: code rule keeping rung 4 only on unanimous HIGH-confidence runs with a clean survey
glossary.fact_conflicts: places the model's reading contradicts a Step 1 fact, logged for Peter
glossary.p_rating: Peter's own 1-10 rating of a work in cortex.db
glossary.substrate: paper type S1-S14; sizing family RAW (unsized, bleeds) or SEMI_SIZED
glossary.presence: whether the sheet registers with force at viewing distance (E1); measured as coverage, darkest-tone share, deepest ink, edge mix
glossary.tonally complex: a cell whose ink spans 3+ of 9 tonal bands; tonal variety, not a pass count
glossary.orientation family: a cluster of stroke directions (axial 0-180); says nothing about which way a mark travelled
glossary.tie-break: run 3, dispatched only when runs 1 and 2 split, classifying only the split axes
glossary.schema version: v2 (13 axes, first runs) or v2.1 (14 axes); every run is validated under its own
glossary.evidence_run: the run whose written reasoning is kept as representative for a resolved axis

pipeline.name: deterministic measurement
pipeline.input: TIFF 16-bit master /mnt/c/cortex/images/TIFF 16-BIT/t_NNN.tif (+ 2576px analysis JPEG for field_scale/gesture topology)
pipeline.output: data/measurements/<group>/T_NNN.json, one file per group, overwrite by work_id (deterministic)

groups.segmentation: A: elements (connected ink >= 0.5 cell length, orientation-split by structure tensor), splatter attached to parent elements (per-blob then per-cluster vote), independent residue (individual + populations with width/tone/interval constancy)
groups.boundary_profile: B: per-element per-cell edge segments; trait HARD | SOFT_FEATHERED | BROKEN_RAGGED | UNCERTAIN_BLOOM_FAMILY | UNCLASSIFIED from width/fill_ratio_p10/ring_depth/frag_count; mask_reconstruction_reliable flag
groups.pass_overlap: C: candidate cells (ink density >= 0.3 or >= 2 elements) with density, darkness, tone_std, band_area_fractions (9 bands), n_bands_occupying (bands >= 15% of cell), entropy, coherence, orientation peaks; not a verdict
groups.gesture_profile: D: per element skeleton longest path, width profile, endpoint fill/fragment evidence at radii 50/100/200/300 px, likely_failed (fill@200 <= 0.30, advisory), width_turn events
groups.field_scale: E: num_masses (blur sigma 0.08*short side, threshold band<=4, >=1% area), mass displacement label CENTRED|<compass>_SLIGHT|<compass>_MARKED (<0.05 / >0.15 of half-diagonal), element_groupings
groups.voids: held voids H1..: closing of structural ink (disk r=0.2*short side) AND paper with structural ink before/after along row or column within 2r; per void cells, area_fraction, held_axes, touches_edges, perimeter_by_cell{ink_edge_px, crisp_fraction (Sobel/8 >= 0.06)}, open_perimeter_fraction, marks_inside(+cells)
groups.orientation_field: structure tensor (sigma 0.01*short side) on ~1440px luma with specks painted out by grey closing (25px); axial angles 0-180 (0 horizontal, 90 vertical, CCW, y up); dominant family = histogram peak (36 bins); second family ('opposing' in the JSON) = peak >= 45 deg away and >= 0.35 of dominant; axial, so it cannot tell a movement from its reverse or a crossing from an opposition: the facts call them main and second families and the model decides opposition from the images; per-cell angle/strength; extent = share of 6 long-axis positions
groups.presence: deterministic/presence.py, v2.1: ink_coverage (share of sheet that is ink), darkest_share (share in the two darkest of nine bands), deepest_ink (5th-percentile ink luma), paper_tone (median non-ink luma), tonal_range, edge_mix from boundary_profile traits (crisp, soft_or_bloom, broken shares); grounds E1; run alone with process_computed.py --presence-only
groups.frame_contact: per edge N S W E: contact_fraction, runs (fractions along edge), margin_fraction; weight_centre (darkness below paper median tone) and densest_point (blur sigma 0.08) with cell and anchors within 0.05 (sheet centre, centre lines, edge midpoints)

shared.ink: Rec.709 luma quantised to 9 equal bands over 0-65535; ink = band <= 4 (darkest 5 of 9)
shared.grid: landscape 6 cols A-F x 3 rows; portrait 3 cols A-C x 6 rows; cell_at(x,y,w,h)
shared.sheet_view: deterministic/sheet.py: block-mean luma to ~1440px long side; structural_ink = ink minus components < 0.0005 of sheet

pipeline.name: lean ensembled classification + rating
pipeline.model_calls: 2 independent runs per painting, plus a third only as a tie-break on the axes they split (pipeline/tiebreak_step2.py); fresh Claude Code subagents on Opus 5.5 (no API key), one painting at a time, only with Peter's written go-ahead; measured about 110k subagent tokens and 2 min per full run, a tie-break about 76% of that
pipeline.prepare: pipeline/prepare_step2.py T_NNN: renders facts (step2/facts.py), fills prompts/step2_prompt_v2.md (step2/fill.py, refuses unfilled placeholders), writes data/step2_runs/T_NNN/{prompt.md, dispatch.md, manifest.json}; refuses if run*.json exist unless --force, which moves them to superseded-<timestamp>/
pipeline.run: each subagent reads prompt.md, views the 5 images in order, writes only the JSON object to runN.json; may read the schema, nothing else
resolve_algorithm: load runs listed in manifest; missing/unparseable file = invalid run

validate_run under the manifest's schema_version (v2 runs keep their 13-axis schema; v2.1 has 14): jsonschema Draft 2020-12 from step2/schema.py, unique part tags, P parts not VOID and V parts VOID, a P1, every cell on the sheet's grid for its orientation; work_id must equal the painting; invalid runs excluded, errors reported in runs_invalid

axis_errors per run: a value contradicting its own fields (B2 CLEAN with a marker, D1 above ACCEPTED with route NONE, A1 rung 3+ without HEAVY demand, D3 act counts, a rung resting on (C) with no counterfactual, a counterfactual target not among the parts, a survey entry with no cells, C4 master with fewer than four shift tests) drops only that run's vote on that axis (excluded_votes)
per axis per valid run: if value is rung 4, survey_contradictions(axis, record, measurements); any contradiction -> that run's value becomes rung 3 (recorded in downgrades)

majority via gemini_synthesis.agreement_from_values over final values: UNANIMOUS or MAJORITY (> half) resolves; SPLIT or DISPERSED -> value None; fewer than 2 valid runs -> None (SINGLE_RUN / NO_DATA); never averaged

master gate: resolved rung 4 stands only if all dispatched runs valid, every run's final value is that rung-4 value at confidence HIGH with non-empty master_survey, and no downgrade; else value = rung 3, gated=true, evidence strips master_survey and sets gated_from_rung_4

evidence = observation, rung_check, counterfactual, decision_note, master_survey, demand, markers, evidence_route, acts from one run, named in evidence_run: representative, not agreed wording; the first run whose value equals the resolved value, or after the gate the first run that chose rung 4 (never a dissenting lower reading); a standing rung 4 carries survey_verified (False = Step 1 could not check it, not cleared)
composition_mode and geometry voted the same way; parts_by_run and fact_conflicts (tagged by run) carried for Peter's review, never resolved in code

rating: weighted mean rung over axes with a rung, mapped through rating_weights.json anchors (piecewise linear, 0->1 and 4->10 fixed); NOT_PRESENT = inapplicable, left out; unresolved / NOT_ESTABLISHED = applicable but unsettled: left out of the point rating and reported as weight_coverage and rating_bounds (every unsettled axis at its lowest and at rung 4); provisional below 80% coverage or with a weight-2+ axis unsettled

survey_crosscheck.any_axis: a master_survey item with holds=false is a contradiction
survey_crosscheck.C1: find the first measured void (largest first) whose perimeter cells the survey covers at least half of; if none, no Step 1 check and survey_verified=False (model V1 need not be H1; large voids unmeasured); if found, every perimeter cell must be surveyed, each must have crisp_fraction >= 0.1 (a findable edge; soft limits allowed since v2.1), and open_perimeter_fraction must be <= 0.1
survey_crosscheck.A1: every pass_overlap candidate with n_bands_occupying >= 3 (marked 'tonally complex' in the facts; tonal variety, not a pass count) must appear in the survey cells
survey_crosscheck.C4: survey must contain items with edge N, S, E and W

pipeline.calibration_report: pipeline/calibration_report.py -> data/step2_results/calibration_report.md: per work Peter vs engine rating and unresolved axes; MAE; signed error overall and split at Peter 5; count more than a point off; Spearman engine vs Peter; D3 watch (rating with and without D3, D3 rung vs A1/A3/C1/C3); per axis unanimous/majority/unresolved counts, rung distribution 0-4, Spearman rung vs p_rating; rung-4 list (hand-check) and gated list

principles: Step 1 outranks the model: facts are authoritative in the prompt; conflicts go to fact_conflicts for Peter, never resolved by code or model
Step 1 is validated against Peter's eye (overlays), never against a model
every judgment that can be measured is measured first; the model judges only what measurement cannot reach
honesty through rarity, evenly spaced (Peter 2026-09-24): rung 0 structural failure (occasional), 1 competent (common), 2 strong (common), 3 excellent (occasional), 4 master (rare)
failure rungs are structural or dominant: a rung-0 fault must sit in a structural position, recur in two regions, or run through most of the sheet

whole-sheet axes (A1 A2 B1 B2 C2 C4 E1) are judged on the sheet as a whole; instance axes (A3 C1 C3 C5 D1 D2 D3) take the strongest instance only if it is in a principal part (P1-P3) or V1; replaced 'strongest instance decides' (2026-09-24), which let T_188's best fragments carry each axis

style-neutral: the body of work spans single gestures, all-over fields, centred masses, sparse marks, layered passes, soft and crisp voids; where a rung offers routes joined by 'or' they are equal (C2 centred-active, C3 single developed movement, C4 composed margins, C1 soft findable voids, A2 one held edge kind)
observation before value; rung_check states the next rung's condition and what fails it; 'conservative' is not a reason; no over-award warnings in the prompt
counterfactual C1-C3 on every rung claiming dependency: commit target+prediction, evaluate that prediction, ground at named cells
studio conditions are neutral: composite mega-brush seams, glued tufts, 3+ staged dilutions
prompt never mentions scoring or ratings; rating is code-only, weights readable/adjustable by Peter
consistency via ensembling (3 runs voted), not finer decomposition (the archived 14-step prompt showed 30-70% blind-read disagreement)
archive, never delete, retired work; never hand-edit 11-Painting-Archive (generated from cortex.db)
hard_rules_operational: no model/engine run without Peter's explicit written go-ahead each time
one painting at a time; never batch or parallelize model runs
Step 1 only under the 3 GB per-painting cap; never two capped heavy processes at once on the 8 GB VM
commit on main in ~/NEON (vault convention); attribution trailer per session instructions
no em dashes in Claude's prose to Peter

gates_before_calibration.what: eye-check data/validation/T_NNN_step1_overlay.png (cyan held voids, green/red crisp/soft limit, orange main / magenta second orientation family / grey per-cell direction, yellow edge-contact bars, white ring weight centre, yellow ring densest point)
written go-ahead for each painting; each result reviewed with Peter before the next
after the 16-work set: refit step2/rating_weights.json from the calibration report; then decide rollout pacing

known_limits: voids wider than ~40% of the short side are not measured (closing radius 0.2); e.g. T_326 arc interior; prompt tells the model to read them from images; a convex-hull-concavity method is Peter's call
pale washes lighter than band 4 count as paper, so voids can run under light slabs
void corners rounded by the closing disk
splatter streaks larger than the speck cutoff can still register as orientation
width_turn is noisy on massed sheets where the traced path winds
tonal-complexity proxy = 3+ tonal bands over the whole cell (includes paper bands); renamed from 'heavy' in v2.1 because it measures tonal variety, not passes; heavy demand is the model's call
orientation is axial (0-180): it cannot separate opposing travel from crossing strokes
presence thresholds are unvalidated beyond the first three runs (T_188 35% coverage / 8% darkest vs 58-71% / 38-43% on Peter's 7 and 9)
rung-4 vs rung-3 two-run split stays unresolved (vote before gate, spec order)
rating weights are a pre-calibration guess
segmentation_likely_failed endpoint flag calibrated on two paintings only
batch CLIs stop at the first failure (deferred minor)

rules.title: What each rung means.
rules.text:
Every ladder has the same shape:

| Rung | Meaning | How often it occurs in a body of work |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | A structural failure | Occasional |
| 1 | Competent, well-made | Common |
| 2 | Strong: a named quality clearly achieved | Common |
| 3 | Excellent: the quality achieved in a compound, demanding form | Occasional |
| 4 | Master: the rung 3 quality held everywhere it applies, without a single exception, plus a further property | Rare |

Each rung above 1 names a specific condition. A sheet reaches it when the condition is visibly met and not otherwise.

rules.title: Rung 4 requires a complete survey.
rules.text: To record rung 4, fill `master_survey`: list every place the rung's condition applies (every structural edge, every part, every overlap, as the axis names), and state for each that the condition holds there. One place where it does not hold, or one place the images cannot resolve at their resolution, means the axis is rung 3. Rung 4 is never recorded at `MODERATE` or `LOW` confidence.

rules.title: Failure rungs are structural or dominant.
rules.text: A rung 0 fault must sit in a structural position (on the primary, at the principal void, at a pivot), recur in two separate regions, or dominate the sheet: a fault that runs through most of the painted area (bleed through most edges, mud through most overlaps, most of the ink blurred or blown out) decides the axis even where no single place is structural. A single slip in a peripheral passage is recorded in the `decision_note` and does not decide the axis, except at rung 4, where any exception counts.

rules.title: Observe, then classify.
rules.text: Write the `observation` first, in plain descriptive words with cells named and no ladder vocabulary. Then choose the `value`. The value follows from the observation as written. If it does not, change the value, never the observation.

rules.title: Check your rung and the one above it.
rules.text: In `rung_check`, state the chosen value's condition and the observation that meets it. Then state the next rung's condition and the specific thing on the sheet that fails it. A reason names a cell, a part, or a missing property. "Being conservative" is not a reason. If the sheet meets the next rung's condition, the next rung is the answer.

rules.title: Compound conditions need one connected story.
rules.text: Where a rung names two properties, they must depend on each other in the same place. A property that would hold anyway, or that follows from a part simply being large, does not count.

rules.title: Whole sheet, or strongest principal instance.
rules.text:
Axes are of two kinds.
- *Whole-sheet axes* (A1, A2, B1, B2, C2, C4, E1) describe the sheet as a whole. A strong passage lifts the value only when the rest of the sheet also meets the rungs below it; one fine passage on a sheet that otherwise fails the lower rung does not carry the axis.
- *Instance axes* (A3, C1, C3, C5, D1, D2, D3) take the strongest instance that meets a rung, provided it sits in a principal part (`P1` to `P3`) or is `V1`. An instance in a peripheral fragment cannot carry the axis.

On both kinds, a rung 0 fault under rule 3 decides the axis, and rung 4 is a claim about every instance.

rules.title: One observation may serve several axes
rules.text: when each axis tests a different property of it.

rules.title: Evaluate what is present, on its own terms.
rules.text: This body of work spans many strategies: a single gesture, an all-over field, a centred mass, a sparse mark on open paper, stacked or layered passes, soft voids and crisp ones. Where a condition offers more than one route to a rung ("or"), the routes are equal; no strategy ranks above another. One gesture or many, the same ladders apply. `NOT_PRESENT` means the thing the axis measures is absent from this sheet. `NOT_ESTABLISHED` means the images do not resolve it. Both are decided before the ladder and neither is a rung.

rules.title: Confidence.
rules.text: Each axis carries `HIGH`, `MODERATE` or `LOW`. Below `HIGH`, write a `decision_note`: the value you did not choose and the one observation that decided it. Confidence never changes which value the evidence supports.

definitions.Structural position: Within the primary part, at the limit of the principal void, or at a place where two movements meet.
definitions.Structural edge: The primary's outline, every limit of a held void, and every junction.
definitions.Held: A void is held when ink lies on two opposite sides of it and its limit is findable against each.
definitions.Junction: Where a part's edge meets another part or a held void. An edge against open, unheld paper is not a junction. Two junctions are distinct only if, along the boundary between them, there is a stretch where the edge is not shared. One continuous shared edge is one junction however many cells it crosses.
definitions.Dry brush: Gaps running parallel to the stroke's travel. It is a technique, not a broken edge. Gaps that are irregular or cross the direction of travel are broken.
definitions.Movement: A direction that governs a set of passes: a sweep, a rotation, a fan radiating from a centre, a stack. Read movements from the images; the orientation facts locate stroke directions but do not say which way a mark travelled.
definitions.Full length: Contiguous cells reaching both the first and the last third of the sheet's long axis.
definitions.Heavy demand: A cell carrying three or more overlapping passes, wet meeting wet where neither edge survives, or a rewetted area shown by a ring at its edge. Read it from the images; a tonally complex cell in the facts is a place to look, not proof.
definitions.Findable limit: An edge you can trace: crisp, or soft but settling to a line. A bled edge has no findable limit.

counterfactual_protocol.C1: Name the target (a part, a void or an event) and its cells. State what you expect to change if it were removed, or, for a void, filled with the neighbouring tone, or, where an axis says so, shifted by one cell. Target and prediction come before the result.
counterfactual_protocol.C2: If the result does not support the rung you expected, that is the result. Do not switch target or prediction because the first came back unhelpful.
counterfactual_protocol.C3: as a present-tense claim about two named things at named cells. *"Filling V1 in C2–D3 merges P1 and P2 into one mass and P2's rotation no longer reads against P1's"* is grounded. *"Filling it would weaken the composition"* is not.

A1.title: MATERIAL CONTROL
A1.question: Did the ink's behaviour on this paper stay governed?

ladder.condition: Per rule 3 (a structural position, two separate regions, or most of the sheet): migration runs past any limit the mark could have had, or overlapping passes collapse into a flat tone with neither pass identifiable
Ink behaves as this paper and load predict; no structural loss

`GOVERNED`, and a material behaviour itself forms an edge or shape the structure uses, named: a bleed halted at a findable limit that bounds a void, a bloom contained by dry passes, a translucent overlap that makes the tone a junction depends on
`MATERIAL_SHAPES`, and that same behaviour sits in a cell of heavy demand, where loss was likeliest

`MATERIAL_SHAPES_UNDER_LOAD`, and every heavy-demand cell on the sheet stays governed and legible under `crop`, and two different material behaviours each do named structural work in separate regions. Survey: every heavy-demand cell, and every cell the overlap facts mark tonally complex.

notes: Record `demand`: `LIGHT`, `MODERATE` (two overlapping passes, or a pooled deposit) or `HEAVY` (as defined).

A2.title: EDGE COMMAND
A2.question: Do the edges vary, and does the variation follow the structure?

ladder.condition: Bled or broken edges run along a structural edge, or along most of the sheet's edges
Edges keep a findable limit where it matters; one kind dominates, or kinds vary without following anything

Two or more kinds are used, and the kind changes where the structural role changes, at two named places (for example, crisp at the void, dry brush at a leading terminal, soft where one pass sinks behind another); or one kind is used throughout and held to a findable limit along every structural edge, including two named places where it was likeliest to fail

`EDGES_DIFFERENTIATED`, and an edge alone carries a relationship: a crisp shared edge makes ink and void lock together at a junction, or a softened edge alone sets one pass behind another where their tones are the same

`EDGE_CARRIES`, and every structural edge on the sheet has the kind its role calls for with no exception under `crop`, and edge alone carries at least two separate relationships in different regions. Survey: every structural edge.

notes: Edge kinds: crisp, soft (feathered to a findable limit), dry brush, bled (no findable limit), broken.

A3.title: STROKE CONVICTION
A3.question: Do the principal strokes read as committed, continuous acts?
A3.uses_facts: largest deposits, stroke endpoint hints, width vs turn

ladder.condition: A failure signature in `P1`, or in two other principal strokes
Principal strokes proceed without failure signatures

`SOUND`, and a principal stroke carries its direction through a change without breaking: a turn with a continuous tapered profile, or a run from saturated to dry brush with the gaps parallel to travel

`COMMITTED`, and that stroke spans the full length with the marks of speed visible on it (dry-brush streaking parallel to travel, splatter trailing its path), while every phase of it inside the sheet stays sound

`SPEED_WITHOUT_HASTE`, and every stroke on the sheet is free of every failure signature under `crop`, each principal stroke's width changes only where pressure or direction visibly changes, and at least one principal stroke has both its entry and its terminal inside the sheet, both resolved. Survey: every stroke that is a part.

notes: Failure signatures: a fuzzy or dragging start; a hesitation bulge or dot; low-velocity drag; an unmotivated break or tremor; a hollow or twisted turn; an abrupt stop with no exit direction; a premature fade; a doubled or offset corrective retrace. A phase that runs off the sheet is neither sound nor failed. A flagged endpoint in `known_facts` is advisory only: confirm or reject it against the image before it decides anything.
`NOT_PRESENT` if no stroke or pass group on the sheet can be judged as a single act (a field of washes, a poured or pressed mass).

B1.title: LAYER ARCHITECTURE
B1.question: Where passes overlap, do they stay distinct and build a consistent depth?

ladder.condition: Per rule 3 (a structural position, two separate regions, or most of the sheet), overlapping passes fuse and neither pass's identity survives
Overlapping passes stay individually readable
`LEGIBLE`, and the same tonal register sits at the same depth wherever it appears, including in regions that are not adjacent
`ORDERED`, and the darkest register is confined to named structural positions and absent elsewhere, and those positions are not simply the innermost layer of a nested stack

`DARK_PLACED`, and every overlap on the sheet stays legible under `crop`, and every tonal register from the palest wash to the darkest does a separate named spatial job. Survey: every overlap cell and every register.

notes: `NOT_PRESENT` if no passes overlap.

B2.title: RESOLUTION
B2.question: Did the sheet stop where its structure was complete?

ladder.condition: A marker inside `V1` or at `P1`'s end, or markers in two separate regions
No marker in a structural position; at most one peripheral marker
No marker anywhere on the sheet
`CLEAN`, and each ink part costs something named when removed **(C)**, tested on every part up to four

`ECONOMICAL`, and every part and residue population costs something when removed **(C)**, and no two parts do the same job: each removal costs something different. Survey: every part and every residue population.

notes: Closure markers:
- **Clutter** (`CLUTTER`): marks inside a held void with no relation to its limits or to the direction of the part they came from. Splatter lying along its parent's direction of travel is related.
- **Unresolved end** (`UNRESOLVED_END`): a principal part that dissolves into directionless scrub, neither terminating nor running off the sheet.
- **Filling** (`FILLING`): marks added into a void that shrink or blur its shape.
- **Retrace** (`RETRACE`): a doubled or offset corrective track.

C1.title: VOID
C1.question: Is the unpainted paper a shaped, load-bearing part of the structure?

ladder.condition: Unpainted paper exists only as margin or gaps; no void is held
A void is held, with findable limits
`SHAPED`, and filling it costs the structure something named **(C)**: two parts merge, a movement loses its channel, or a counter-movement loses its separation

`LOAD_BEARING`, and the void's limits are shared with ink at two distinct junctions, each a findable limit (crisp or soft), its interior carries no unrelated marks, and in `inverted` it reads as a coherent shape in its own right

`INTERLOCKED`, and every stretch of the void's perimeter is a findable limit shared with ink or the sheet edge, with no stretch bled or left open, and it does two separate named structural jobs at once (for example, it both separates two opposing movements and sets the sheet's axis of symmetry), and in `inverted` it reads as the principal figure. Survey: the whole perimeter of `V1`, cell by cell.

notes: `NOT_PRESENT` if ink covers the sheet with no unpainted shape.

C2.title: EQUILIBRIUM
C2.question: How is the sheet's weight handled?

ladder.condition: Weight is displaced toward an edge, nothing checks it, and the region opposite is passive
Weight is centred, symmetric, or answered only by the mass's own even spread

Displaced weight is answered by a named counter of different size or kind (a smaller dense part, an accent, a held void) in a named position opposite it; or centred weight is made active by named internal contrasts that pull against the centring (dense against open, dark against pale, one limb against another). A single part can counterweight itself when its densest passage sits opposite its own displacement.

`COUNTERWEIGHTED`, and the balance holds through opposing forces, not mass alone: two movements, or a movement and a held void, pull against each other so that removing either **(C)** tips the sheet or sends the other off the edge

`HELD_IN_TENSION`, and every part and every held void takes part in the balance: removing any one **(C)** visibly shifts it, and no region of the sheet is passive. Survey: every part and void, each with its own test.

C3.title: DIRECTIONAL STRUCTURE
C3.question: What organises movement across the sheet?
C3.uses_facts: masses at field scale, orientation families

ladder.condition: Directions conflict with no locatable relation between them, and the masses do not read as one field
One movement governs; any others are incidental

A second movement runs against the first and stands in a named relation to it (meeting it at a pivot, bounded by it, or answering it across a void); or the single movement develops along its length in named stages (it turns, fans, gathers or releases) that organise the sheet

Two opposing movements each span at least a third of the long axis and share a named centre, void or axis of symmetry that makes the sheet read as one image; or one movement spans the full length and every other part on the sheet takes its direction from it, so the sheet reads as one image

`MOVEMENT_UNIFIES`, and every part on the sheet aligns with, counters, or resolves the governing movement or movements, with none incidental, and every place where movements meet or turn is resolved cleanly, with no collision, mud or blur. Survey: every part, each with its role.

notes: On an `ALL_OVER` sheet, a single movement is the field's macro-rhythm (a loop, a drift, a pulse across the whole). If none exists, the value is `SCATTERED`.

C4.title: FRAME ENGAGEMENT
C4.question: How does the structure meet the sheet's four edges?

ladder.condition: The principal part floats with no relation to any edge, or is clipped by an edge in a way that cuts off its own structure (a centre, a turn or a void lost off the sheet)
The structure sits within margins, or runs off the edges as continuation

One named edge relation does structural work: a movement exits and implies its continuation; a part stops just short of an edge and compresses the space there; a channel or axis runs parallel to an edge; or the structure's centre or hub sits on an edge midpoint, the centre line or the sheet's centre. A placement on its own reaches this rung and no higher.

Three or more edges each do a different named job (for example: exit and continuation, compression, alignment, release into open paper), and the structure's centre, hub or axis is placed in named relation to the sheet; or the structure sits within the margins and the margins themselves are composed: the open paper at three or more edges does different named work (compression on one side, release on another), and the structure's centre, hub or axis is placed in named relation to the sheet

`EDGES_COMPOSED` on all four edges, and shifting the whole structure one cell in any direction **(C)** breaks a named relation at an edge: every edge relation is exact. Survey: all four edges, and all four shift tests.

C5.title: LOAD-BEARING PARTS
C5.question: Do the parts beyond the primary carry load that nothing else could?

ladder.condition: Every tested part can be removed at no named cost
A tested part carries load, but a named substitute could carry it
A tested part carries load that no remaining part could carry
`NECESSARY`, and removing that part changes a named property of `P1` itself (its direction reads differently, a limit loses definition, or its weight goes unanswered), not only the sheet around it
Every ink part and `V1` is necessary, and at least two parts other than `P1` are reciprocal with it, each through a different property. Survey: every part and `V1`, each with its own test.

notes: Test the ink parts other than `P1`, up to three (every part at rung 4). For each, run **(C)** on its removal. Where removal costs something, name the closest substitute still present (including `P1`) and run **(C)** again: could it carry that load from where it is? State why it can or cannot, by position, extent or kind.
`NOT_PRESENT` if the sheet has only one ink part.

D1.title: CHANCE INTEGRATION
D1.question: Where chance entered (bloom, backrun, splatter, drip, run), what did the painting do with it?

ladder.condition: The event breaks a structural edge or litters a held void
The event stands, neither disrupting the structure nor developed by it
A part visibly relates to the event, by a named route

The event is built into the structure: its placement, extent and relation to the bounding structure do named structural work, by a named route. Judge what the sheet shows, not how the event came about

`GENERATED`, and the passage's structure depends on the material behaviour: removing the event **(C)** removes the passage's structure, not its decoration, and every other chance event on the sheet is at least `INCORPORATED`. Survey: every chance event.

notes: A splatter population counts as one event. Events that affect each other count as one. Classify the strongest.

Moving above `ACCEPTED` needs an `evidence_route`: contained by adjacent dry passes (`CONTAINED_BY_DRY_PASSES`); the same effect repeated elsewhere (`REPEATED_ELSEWHERE`); a limit sharper and more exactly placed than the paper's own spread produces elsewhere on the sheet (`PRECISE_LIMIT`); or a part's continuation visibly adjusting to the event (`CONTINUATION_ADJUSTS`). The event's own edge kind is not a route by itself.
`NOT_PRESENT` if no chance event is visible. `evidence_route` is `NONE` at rungs 0 and 1.

D2.title: VISUAL CADENCE
D2.question: Where a unit repeats (spokes, stacked passes, parallel strokes), does the sequence do something?

ladder.condition: A repeated unit exists
Interval, tone, width or length changes along the sequence in step with a named change elsewhere: spokes lengthen toward a counterweight, tone darkens toward a hub
`VARIED_WITH_PURPOSE`, and the sequence contains a deliberate break (a missing unit, a gap, a unit out of phase) that the structure uses, named **(C)**
`SYNCOPATED`, and every unit in the sequence follows the named change except the deliberate break, and the sequence spans the full length. Survey: every unit, in order.

notes: A repeated unit is two or more parts or passes made the same way. Splatter is not a repeated unit unless it is placed as a sequence. Where `known_facts` gives a repeated population's width/tone/interval constancy, treat a `false` there as confirmation a measured property varies, not proof alone that the variation is purposeful. The image must still show it stepping with a named change.
`NOT_PRESENT` if nothing repeats. There is no rung 0: steady repetition is not a fault.

D3.title: RISK
D3.question: How difficult was what this sheet attempted, and did it hold?

ladder.condition: A high-difficulty act was attempted and visibly failed in a structural position
No high-difficulty act, or one that the structure does not depend on
A named high-difficulty act holds, and the structure depends on it **(C)**
Two or more high-difficulty acts hold, and the sheet's principal relation (its void, its opposition or its balance) depends on both
Three or more different high-difficulty acts hold with no failure anywhere under `crop`, and the structure depends on each **(C)**. Survey: every act attempted on the sheet, held or not.

notes: High-difficulty acts (closed list):
- `FULL_LENGTH_STROKE`: one continuous stroke across the full length;
- `CLEAN_VOID_AMID_WET`: a crisp-edged void kept clean while wet passes surround it;
- `WET_INTO_WET_AT_STRUCTURAL_EDGE`: wet meeting wet at a structural edge that stays governed;
- `OPPOSED_MOVEMENTS_WITHOUT_MUD`: two opposing movements built on one sheet without collision or mud;
- `LEGIBLE_HEAVY_DEMAND_CELL`: a heavy-demand cell whose passes stay legible.

E1.title: PRESENCE
E1.question: Does the sheet register with force at viewing distance?

ladder.condition: The sheet reads as mostly paper with nothing decisive: its darkest ink stays mid-grey, or its principal marks are blurred, bled or blown out, so at field scale nothing holds the eye
The principal part reads clearly at field scale, with at least one decisive dark or findable limit; the rest may be quiet
`PRESENT`, and the sheet carries a full range from near-black to open paper, with its darkest ink or crispest limits in named structural positions, so the principal part holds the whole sheet
`COMMANDING`, and the contrast itself does structural work: the darkest ink meets the brightest paper at a named junction or void, so the sheet's force and its structure are the same event
`ARRESTING`, and every part holds its own weight at field scale, with no passage gone grey, bled or inert. Survey: every part and `V1`.

notes: Presence is not coverage. One decisive dark stroke on open paper can command a sheet; a sheet covered in pale, blurred wash can barely register. Judge at field scale first (`lowpass`), then confirm on `bw`.

Failure rungs are structural or dominant.** A rung 0 fault must sit in a structural position (on the primary, at the principal void, at a pivot), recur in two separate regions, or dominate the sheet: a fault that runs through most of the painted area (bleed through most edges, mud through most overlaps, most of the ink blurred or blown out) decides the axis even where no single place is structural. A single slip in a peripheral passage is recorded in the `decision_note` and does not decide the axis, except at rung 4, where any exception counts.

**4. Observe, then classify.** Write the `observation` first, in plain descriptive words with cells named and no ladder vocabulary. Then choose the `value`. The value follows from the observation as written. If it does not, change the value, never the observation.

**5. Check your rung and the one above it.** In `rung_check`, state the chosen value's condition and the observation that meets it. Then state the next rung's condition and the specific thing on the sheet that fails it. A reason names a cell, a part, or a missing property. "Being conservative" is not a reason. If the sheet meets the next rung's condition, the next rung is the answer.

**6. Compound conditions need one connected story.** Where a rung names two properties, they must depend on each other in the same place. A property that would hold anyway, or that follows from a part simply being large, does not count.

**7. Whole sheet, or strongest principal instance.** Axes are of two kinds.
- *Whole-sheet axes* (A1, A2, B1, B2, C2, C4, E1) describe the sheet as a whole. A strong passage lifts the value only when the rest of the sheet also meets the rungs below it; one fine passage on a sheet that otherwise fails the lower rung does not carry the axis.
- *Instance axes* (A3, C1, C3, C5, D1, D2, D3) take the strongest instance that meets a rung, provided it sits in a principal part (`P1` to `P3`) or is `V1`. An instance in a peripheral fragment cannot carry the axis.

On both kinds, a rung 0 fault under rule 3 decides the axis, and rung 4 is a claim about every instance.

**8. One observation may serve several axes** when each axis tests a different property of it.

**9. Evaluate what is present, on its own terms.** This body of work spans many strategies: a single gesture, an all-over field, a centred mass, a sparse mark on open paper, stacked or layered passes, soft voids and crisp ones. Where a condition offers more than one route to a rung ("or"), the routes are equal; no strategy ranks above another. One gesture or many, the same ladders apply. `NOT_PRESENT` means the thing the axis measures is absent from this sheet. `NOT_ESTABLISHED` means the images do not resolve it. Both are decided before the ladder and neither is a rung.

**10. Confidence.** Each axis carries `HIGH`, `MODERATE` or `LOW`. Below `HIGH`, write a `decision_note`: the value you did not choose and the one observation that decided it. Confidence never changes which value the evidence supports.

---

## PARTS

Before the axes, name the sheet's parts. Keep it short: the parts that carry the structure, at most six ink parts and two voids.

- `P1`, `P2`, … : ink parts, largest or most commanding first. A part is whatever acts as one unit: a single stroke, a fan of passes, a stacked block, a dark accent. Kind: `STROKE`, `PASS_GROUP`, `MASS`, `ACCENT`.
- `V1`, `V2` : unpainted shapes with findable limits, read from `inverted` and confirmed on `bw`. `V1` is the principal void. Kind: `VOID`.
- Residue (splatter, drips, specks) is not a part unless it acts as one.

Record each part's cells. Record `composition_mode`: `HIERARCHICAL` (a primary with subordinate parts), `ALL_OVER` (no primary; parts of equal accent across the sheet), or `SINGLE_GESTURE` (one part is the painting). Record `geometry`: `RADIAL`, `ARC`, `ROTATIONAL`, `LINEAR`, `STACKED`, `MASSED` or `SCATTERED`.

---

## DEFINITIONS

**Structural position.** Within the primary part, at the limit of the principal void, or at a place where two movements meet.

**Structural edge.** The primary's outline, every limit of a held void, and every junction.

**Held.** A void is held when ink lies on two opposite sides of it and its limit is findable against each.

**Junction.** Where a part's edge meets another part or a held void. An edge against open, unheld paper is not a junction. Two junctions are distinct only if, along the boundary between them, there is a stretch where the edge is not shared. One continuous shared edge is one junction however many cells it crosses.

**Dry brush.** Gaps running parallel to the stroke's travel. It is a technique, not a broken edge. Gaps that are irregular or cross the direction of travel are broken.

**Movement.** A direction that governs a set of passes: a sweep, a rotation, a fan radiating from a centre, a stack. Read movements from the images; the orientation facts locate stroke directions but do not say which way a mark travelled.

**Full length.** Contiguous cells reaching both the first and the last third of the sheet's long axis.

**Heavy demand.** A cell carrying three or more overlapping passes, wet meeting wet where neither edge survives, or a rewetted area shown by a ring at its edge. Read it from the images; a tonally complex cell in the facts is a place to look, not proof.

**Principal part.** `P1`, `P2` or `P3`.

**Findable limit.** An edge you can trace: crisp, or soft but settling to a line. A bled edge has no findable limit.

---

## COUNTERFACTUAL TEST

Used wherever an axis says **(C)**.

**C1. Commit first.** Name the target (a part, a void or an event) and its cells. State what you expect to change if it were removed, or, for a void, filled with the neighbouring tone, or, where an axis says so, shifted by one cell. Target and prediction come before the result.

**C2. Evaluate the prediction you committed to.** If the result does not support the rung you expected, that is the result. Do not switch target or prediction because the first came back unhelpful.

**C3. Ground the result** as a present-tense claim about two named things at named cells. *"Filling V1 in C2–D3 merges P1 and P2 into one mass and P2's rotation no longer reads against P1's"* is grounded. *"Filling it would weaken the composition"* is not.

---

## THE AXES

### DOMAIN A: MATERIAL AND MARK

### A1. MATERIAL CONTROL
**Question:** Did the ink's behaviour on this paper stay governed?
*Uses: sizing family, overlap candidates. Images: `analysis`, `crop`, `bw`.*

Record `demand`: `LIGHT`, `MODERATE` (two overlapping passes, or a pooled deposit) or `HEAVY` (as defined).

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `LOST` | Per rule 3 (a structural position, two separate regions, or most of the sheet): migration runs past any limit the mark could have had, or overlapping passes collapse into a flat tone with neither pass identifiable |
| 1 | `GOVERNED` | Ink behaves as this paper and load predict; no structural loss |
| 2 | `MATERIAL_SHAPES` | `GOVERNED`, and a material behaviour itself forms an edge or shape the structure uses, named: a bleed halted at a findable limit that bounds a void, a bloom contained by dry passes, a translucent overlap that makes the tone a junction depends on |
| 3 | `MATERIAL_SHAPES_UNDER_LOAD` | `MATERIAL_SHAPES`, and that same behaviour sits in a cell of heavy demand, where loss was likeliest |
| 4 | `MATERIAL_MASTERED` | `MATERIAL_SHAPES_UNDER_LOAD`, and every heavy-demand cell on the sheet stays governed and legible under `crop`, and two different material behaviours each do named structural work in separate regions. Survey: every heavy-demand cell, and every cell the overlap facts mark tonally complex. |

### A2. EDGE COMMAND
**Question:** Do the edges vary, and does the variation follow the structure?
*Uses: edge segments, sizing family. Images: `bw`, `crop`.*

Edge kinds: crisp, soft (feathered to a findable limit), dry brush, bled (no findable limit), broken.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `EDGES_FAIL` | Bled or broken edges run along a structural edge, or along most of the sheet's edges |
| 1 | `EDGES_HOLD` | Edges keep a findable limit where it matters; one kind dominates, or kinds vary without following anything |
| 2 | `EDGES_DIFFERENTIATED` | Two or more kinds are used, and the kind changes where the structural role changes, at two named places (for example, crisp at the void, dry brush at a leading terminal, soft where one pass sinks behind another); or one kind is used throughout and held to a findable limit along every structural edge, including two named places where it was likeliest to fail |
| 3 | `EDGE_CARRIES` | `EDGES_DIFFERENTIATED`, and an edge alone carries a relationship: a crisp shared edge makes ink and void lock together at a junction, or a softened edge alone sets one pass behind another where their tones are the same |
| 4 | `EDGE_MASTERY` | `EDGE_CARRIES`, and every structural edge on the sheet has the kind its role calls for with no exception under `crop`, and edge alone carries at least two separate relationships in different regions. Survey: every structural edge. |

### A3. STROKE CONVICTION
**Question:** Do the principal strokes read as committed, continuous acts?
*Uses: largest deposits, stroke endpoint hints, width vs turn. Images: `bw`, `crop`.* Judge the strokes of `P1` and the next two parts that are strokes or pass groups.

Failure signatures: a fuzzy or dragging start; a hesitation bulge or dot; low-velocity drag; an unmotivated break or tremor; a hollow or twisted turn; an abrupt stop with no exit direction; a premature fade; a doubled or offset corrective retrace. A phase that runs off the sheet is neither sound nor failed. A flagged endpoint in `known_facts` is advisory only: confirm or reject it against the image before it decides anything.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `HESITANT` | A failure signature in `P1`, or in two other principal strokes |
| 1 | `SOUND` | Principal strokes proceed without failure signatures |
| 2 | `COMMITTED` | `SOUND`, and a principal stroke carries its direction through a change without breaking: a turn with a continuous tapered profile, or a run from saturated to dry brush with the gaps parallel to travel |
| 3 | `SPEED_WITHOUT_HASTE` | `COMMITTED`, and that stroke spans the full length with the marks of speed visible on it (dry-brush streaking parallel to travel, splatter trailing its path), while every phase of it inside the sheet stays sound |
| 4 | `MASTER_STROKE` | `SPEED_WITHOUT_HASTE`, and every stroke on the sheet is free of every failure signature under `crop`, each principal stroke's width changes only where pressure or direction visibly changes, and at least one principal stroke has both its entry and its terminal inside the sheet, both resolved. Survey: every stroke that is a part. |

`NOT_PRESENT` if no stroke or pass group on the sheet can be judged as a single act (a field of washes, a poured or pressed mass).

### DOMAIN B: LAYERING AND RESOLUTION

### B1. LAYER ARCHITECTURE
**Question:** Where passes overlap, do they stay distinct and build a consistent depth?
*Uses: overlap candidates. Images: `bw`, `analysis`, `crop`.*

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `MUDDIED` | Per rule 3 (a structural position, two separate regions, or most of the sheet), overlapping passes fuse and neither pass's identity survives |
| 1 | `LEGIBLE` | Overlapping passes stay individually readable |
| 2 | `ORDERED` | `LEGIBLE`, and the same tonal register sits at the same depth wherever it appears, including in regions that are not adjacent |
| 3 | `DARK_PLACED` | `ORDERED`, and the darkest register is confined to named structural positions and absent elsewhere, and those positions are not simply the innermost layer of a nested stack |
| 4 | `DEPTH_MASTERED` | `DARK_PLACED`, and every overlap on the sheet stays legible under `crop`, and every tonal register from the palest wash to the darkest does a separate named spatial job. Survey: every overlap cell and every register. |

`NOT_PRESENT` if no passes overlap.

### B2. RESOLUTION
**Question:** Did the sheet stop where its structure was complete?
*Uses: splatter populations, held voids (marks inside). Images: `bw`, `inverted`, `analysis`.*

Closure markers:
- **Clutter** (`CLUTTER`): marks inside a held void with no relation to its limits or to the direction of the part they came from. Splatter lying along its parent's direction of travel is related.
- **Unresolved end** (`UNRESOLVED_END`): a principal part that dissolves into directionless scrub, neither terminating nor running off the sheet.
- **Filling** (`FILLING`): marks added into a void that shrink or blur its shape.
- **Retrace** (`RETRACE`): a doubled or offset corrective track.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `WORKED_PAST` | A marker inside `V1` or at `P1`'s end, or markers in two separate regions |
| 1 | `RESOLVED` | No marker in a structural position; at most one peripheral marker |
| 2 | `CLEAN` | No marker anywhere on the sheet |
| 3 | `ECONOMICAL` | `CLEAN`, and each ink part costs something named when removed **(C)**, tested on every part up to four |
| 4 | `INEVITABLE` | `ECONOMICAL`, and every part and residue population costs something when removed **(C)**, and no two parts do the same job: each removal costs something different. Survey: every part and every residue population. |

### DOMAIN C: SPACE AND STRUCTURE

### C1. VOID
**Question:** Is the unpainted paper a shaped, load-bearing part of the structure?
*Uses: held voids. Images: `inverted`, `bw`, `crop`.*

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `LEFTOVER` | Unpainted paper exists only as margin or gaps; no void is held |
| 1 | `SHAPED` | A void is held, with findable limits |
| 2 | `LOAD_BEARING` | `SHAPED`, and filling it costs the structure something named **(C)**: two parts merge, a movement loses its channel, or a counter-movement loses its separation |
| 3 | `INTERLOCKED` | `LOAD_BEARING`, and the void's limits are shared with ink at two distinct junctions, each a findable limit (crisp or soft), its interior carries no unrelated marks, and in `inverted` it reads as a coherent shape in its own right |
| 4 | `VOID_AS_EQUAL` | `INTERLOCKED`, and every stretch of the void's perimeter is a findable limit shared with ink or the sheet edge, with no stretch bled or left open, and it does two separate named structural jobs at once (for example, it both separates two opposing movements and sets the sheet's axis of symmetry), and in `inverted` it reads as the principal figure. Survey: the whole perimeter of `V1`, cell by cell. |

`NOT_PRESENT` if ink covers the sheet with no unpainted shape.

### C2. EQUILIBRIUM
**Question:** How is the sheet's weight handled?
*Uses: weight displacement, orientation families. Images: `lowpass`, `bw`.*

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `SLIDING` | Weight is displaced toward an edge, nothing checks it, and the region opposite is passive |
| 1 | `SETTLED` | Weight is centred, symmetric, or answered only by the mass's own even spread |
| 2 | `COUNTERWEIGHTED` | Displaced weight is answered by a named counter of different size or kind (a smaller dense part, an accent, a held void) in a named position opposite it; or centred weight is made active by named internal contrasts that pull against the centring (dense against open, dark against pale, one limb against another). A single part can counterweight itself when its densest passage sits opposite its own displacement. |
| 3 | `HELD_IN_TENSION` | `COUNTERWEIGHTED`, and the balance holds through opposing forces, not mass alone: two movements, or a movement and a held void, pull against each other so that removing either **(C)** tips the sheet or sends the other off the edge |
| 4 | `POISED` | `HELD_IN_TENSION`, and every part and every held void takes part in the balance: removing any one **(C)** visibly shifts it, and no region of the sheet is passive. Survey: every part and void, each with its own test. |

### C3. DIRECTIONAL STRUCTURE
**Question:** What organises movement across the sheet?
*Uses: masses at field scale, orientation families. Images: `bw`, `lowpass`.*

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `SCATTERED` | Directions conflict with no locatable relation between them, and the masses do not read as one field |
| 1 | `SINGLE_MOVEMENT` | One movement governs; any others are incidental |
| 2 | `MOVEMENT_DEVELOPED` | A second movement runs against the first and stands in a named relation to it (meeting it at a pivot, bounded by it, or answering it across a void); or the single movement develops along its length in named stages (it turns, fans, gathers or releases) that organise the sheet |
| 3 | `MOVEMENT_UNIFIES` | Two opposing movements each span at least a third of the long axis and share a named centre, void or axis of symmetry that makes the sheet read as one image; or one movement spans the full length and every other part on the sheet takes its direction from it, so the sheet reads as one image |
| 4 | `ORCHESTRATED` | `MOVEMENT_UNIFIES`, and every part on the sheet aligns with, counters, or resolves the governing movement or movements, with none incidental, and every place where movements meet or turn is resolved cleanly, with no collision, mud or blur. Survey: every part, each with its role. |

On an `ALL_OVER` sheet, a single movement is the field's macro-rhythm (a loop, a drift, a pulse across the whole). If none exists, the value is `SCATTERED`.

### C4. FRAME ENGAGEMENT
**Question:** How does the structure meet the sheet's four edges?
*Uses: frame contact. Images: `bw`, `lowpass`.*

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `TRAPPED` | The principal part floats with no relation to any edge, or is clipped by an edge in a way that cuts off its own structure (a centre, a turn or a void lost off the sheet) |
| 1 | `CONTAINED_OR_CONTINUING` | The structure sits within margins, or runs off the edges as continuation |
| 2 | `EDGE_ACTIVE` | One named edge relation does structural work: a movement exits and implies its continuation; a part stops just short of an edge and compresses the space there; a channel or axis runs parallel to an edge; or the structure's centre or hub sits on an edge midpoint, the centre line or the sheet's centre. A placement on its own reaches this rung and no higher. |
| 3 | `EDGES_COMPOSED` | Three or more edges each do a different named job (for example: exit and continuation, compression, alignment, release into open paper), and the structure's centre, hub or axis is placed in named relation to the sheet; or the structure sits within the margins and the margins themselves are composed: the open paper at three or more edges does different named work (compression on one side, release on another), and the structure's centre, hub or axis is placed in named relation to the sheet |
| 4 | `FRAME_INEVITABLE` | `EDGES_COMPOSED` on all four edges, and shifting the whole structure one cell in any direction **(C)** breaks a named relation at an edge: every edge relation is exact. Survey: all four edges, and all four shift tests. |

### C5. LOAD-BEARING PARTS
**Question:** Do the parts beyond the primary carry load that nothing else could?
*Images: `bw`, `lowpass`.*

Test the ink parts other than `P1`, up to three (every part at rung 4). For each, run **(C)** on its removal. Where removal costs something, name the closest substitute still present (including `P1`) and run **(C)** again: could it carry that load from where it is? State why it can or cannot, by position, extent or kind.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `REDUNDANT` | Every tested part can be removed at no named cost |
| 1 | `SUPPORTING` | A tested part carries load, but a named substitute could carry it |
| 2 | `NECESSARY` | A tested part carries load that no remaining part could carry |
| 3 | `RECIPROCAL` | `NECESSARY`, and removing that part changes a named property of `P1` itself (its direction reads differently, a limit loses definition, or its weight goes unanswered), not only the sheet around it |
| 4 | `INTERDEPENDENT` | Every ink part and `V1` is necessary, and at least two parts other than `P1` are reciprocal with it, each through a different property. Survey: every part and `V1`, each with its own test. |

`NOT_PRESENT` if the sheet has only one ink part.

### DOMAIN D: CHANCE, RHYTHM AND RISK

### D1. CHANCE INTEGRATION
**Question:** Where chance entered (bloom, backrun, splatter, drip, run), what did the painting do with it?
*Uses: splatter populations, edge segments. Images: `analysis`, `crop`, `bw`.*

A splatter population counts as one event. Events that affect each other count as one. Classify the strongest.

Moving above `ACCEPTED` needs an `evidence_route`: contained by adjacent dry passes (`CONTAINED_BY_DRY_PASSES`); the same effect repeated elsewhere (`REPEATED_ELSEWHERE`); a limit sharper and more exactly placed than the paper's own spread produces elsewhere on the sheet (`PRECISE_LIMIT`); or a part's continuation visibly adjusting to the event (`CONTINUATION_ADJUSTS`). The event's own edge kind is not a route by itself.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `DISRUPTIVE` | The event breaks a structural edge or litters a held void |
| 1 | `ACCEPTED` | The event stands, neither disrupting the structure nor developed by it |
| 2 | `INCORPORATED` | A part visibly relates to the event, by a named route |
| 3 | `GENERATED` | The event is built into the structure: its placement, extent and relation to the bounding structure do named structural work, by a named route. Judge what the sheet shows, not how the event came about |
| 4 | `EXPLOITED` | `GENERATED`, and the passage's structure depends on the material behaviour: removing the event **(C)** removes the passage's structure, not its decoration, and every other chance event on the sheet is at least `INCORPORATED`. Survey: every chance event. |

`NOT_PRESENT` if no chance event is visible. `evidence_route` is `NONE` at rungs 0 and 1.

### D2. VISUAL CADENCE
**Question:** Where a unit repeats (spokes, stacked passes, parallel strokes), does the sequence do something?
*Uses: residue populations. Images: `bw`, `lowpass`.*

A repeated unit is two or more parts or passes made the same way. Splatter is not a repeated unit unless it is placed as a sequence. Where `known_facts` gives a repeated population's width/tone/interval constancy, treat a `false` there as confirmation a measured property varies, not proof alone that the variation is purposeful. The image must still show it stepping with a named change.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `REPEATED` | A repeated unit exists |
| 2 | `VARIED_WITH_PURPOSE` | Interval, tone, width or length changes along the sequence in step with a named change elsewhere: spokes lengthen toward a counterweight, tone darkens toward a hub |
| 3 | `SYNCOPATED` | `VARIED_WITH_PURPOSE`, and the sequence contains a deliberate break (a missing unit, a gap, a unit out of phase) that the structure uses, named **(C)** |
| 4 | `CADENCE_MASTERED` | `SYNCOPATED`, and every unit in the sequence follows the named change except the deliberate break, and the sequence spans the full length. Survey: every unit, in order. |

`NOT_PRESENT` if nothing repeats. There is no rung 0: steady repetition is not a fault.

### D3. RISK
**Question:** How difficult was what this sheet attempted, and did it hold?
*Images: all.*

High-difficulty acts (closed list):
- `FULL_LENGTH_STROKE`: one continuous stroke across the full length;
- `CLEAN_VOID_AMID_WET`: a crisp-edged void kept clean while wet passes surround it;
- `WET_INTO_WET_AT_STRUCTURAL_EDGE`: wet meeting wet at a structural edge that stays governed;
- `OPPOSED_MOVEMENTS_WITHOUT_MUD`: two opposing movements built on one sheet without collision or mud;
- `LEGIBLE_HEAVY_DEMAND_CELL`: a heavy-demand cell whose passes stay legible.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `FAILED_RISK` | A high-difficulty act was attempted and visibly failed in a structural position |
| 1 | `WITHIN_REACH` | No high-difficulty act, or one that the structure does not depend on |
| 2 | `RISK_HELD` | A named high-difficulty act holds, and the structure depends on it **(C)** |
| 3 | `RISK_IS_STRUCTURE` | Two or more high-difficulty acts hold, and the sheet's principal relation (its void, its opposition or its balance) depends on both |
| 4 | `MASTER_RISK` | Three or more different high-difficulty acts hold with no failure anywhere under `crop`, and the structure depends on each **(C)**. Survey: every act attempted on the sheet, held or not. |

### DOMAIN E: PRESENCE

### E1. PRESENCE
**Question:** Does the sheet register with force at viewing distance?
*Uses: presence, edge segments. Images: `lowpass`, `bw`, `analysis`.*

Presence is not coverage. One decisive dark stroke on open paper can command a sheet; a sheet covered in pale, blurred wash can barely register. Judge at field scale first (`lowpass`), then confirm on `bw`.

| Rung | Value | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | `SLIGHT` | The sheet reads as mostly paper with nothing decisive: its darkest ink stays mid-grey, or its principal marks are blurred, bled or blown out, so at field scale nothing holds the eye |
| 1 | `PRESENT` | The principal part reads clearly at field scale, with at least one decisive dark or findable limit; the rest may be quiet |
| 2 | `COMMANDING` | `PRESENT`, and the sheet carries a full range from near-black to open paper, with its darkest ink or crispest limits in named structural positions, so the principal part holds the whole sheet |
| 3 | `ARRESTING` | `COMMANDING`, and the contrast itself does structural work: the darkest ink meets the brightest paper at a named junction or void, so the sheet's force and its structure are the same event |
| 4 | `PRESENCE_MASTERED` | `ARRESTING`, and every part holds its own weight at field scale, with no passage gone grey, bled or inert. Survey: every part and `V1`. |

---

## OUTPUT

Emit one JSON object, and nothing else, that validates against the supplied schema:

- `work_id`
- `parts`: `{tag, kind, cells}` for each part
- `composition_mode`, `geometry`
- `fact_conflicts`: `{fact, seen, cells}` for each place your reading seemed to contradict a known fact, or `[]`
- `axes`: one object per axis, keyed `A1` to `E1`:
  - `observation`: one to three sentences, cells named, descriptive words only, written before the value
  - `value`: a value from the ladder, or `NOT_PRESENT` where the axis offers it, or `NOT_ESTABLISHED` on any axis
  - `rung_check`: the chosen value's condition and what meets it; the next rung's condition and what fails it (omit at rung 4)
  - `confidence`, with `decision_note` below `HIGH`
  - `counterfactual`: `{target, cells, predicted, result}` for each **(C)** test the value relies on
  - `master_survey`: at rung 4 only, `{place, cells, holds, note}` for every surveyed place; on C4, add `edge` (`N`, `S`, `E` or `W`) to each edge's entry
  - `demand` (A1); `markers` as `{kind, cells}` (B2); `evidence_route` (D1, `NONE` at rungs 0 and 1); `acts` as `{act, cells, held}` (D3)

Nothing follows the object.

# PART ONE — THE READ

Four sections, in this order. Each takes its axes' findings and says, in
plain critical language, what actually happened and why it matters to
the painting as a whole — not a list of translated labels, a piece of
writing that happens to be fully grounded in them.

Word ceiling per section: about 150 words. Under is always fine.
Padding to reach it is not.

## MATERIAL & MARK-MAKING
*Axes: A1 Material Control, A2 Edge Command, A3 Stroke Conviction*

What actually happened where brush met paper. Containment or collapse,
control at the edges, whether the mark's own body holds together,
whether the stroke's phases — landing, travel, turn, exit — read as
sound or as failure. This is the most physically specific section: name
the actual mechanism, not a verdict about it.

## LAYERING & RESOLUTION
*Axes: B1 Layer Architecture, B2 Resolution*

How the passes stack, whether depth reads consistently and the darks sit
where the structure needs them, and whether the sheet stopped where its
structure was complete. If a closure failure is present, name what it
looks like, at its location.

## SPACE & STRUCTURE
*Axes: C1 Void, C2 Equilibrium, C3 Directional Structure, C4 Frame Engagement, C5 Load-Bearing Parts*

How the composition holds together as a whole, including the unpainted
paper and the sheet's own edges. Where the weight sits
and what answers it, how far the primary gesture's authority actually
reaches, whether the sheet reads as one field or several unrelated
ones, and — this is the load-bearing fact of the section — which
elements are actually necessary and which could be removed at no real
cost. This section should give a reader the clearest sense of the
painting's actual architecture, not just a list of five separate
findings.

## CHANCE, RHYTHM & RISK
*Axes: D1 Chance Integration, D2 Visual Cadence, D3 Risk*

How the accidental was handled, if anything accidental happened at all:
name the specific event and what was done with it (accepted, built on,
or left to sit uncontrolled). Whether a repeated unit does anything. How
much the sheet attempted, and whether it held.

## PRESENCE
*Axis: E1 Presence*

Whether the sheet registers at all at viewing distance, and with what
force: where the darkest ink and the brightest paper are, and whether
the marks hold their weight or go grey, blurred or blown out. About 80
words. If there is no E1 packet above, leave this section out.

---

# PART TWO — NEON

Written last. This is where the record stops explaining itself and
becomes a piece of writing.

<constraints>
**The facts are fixed.** Anything you name has to be there. The
metaphor is yours; the object is not.

**It is not a verdict.** Do not restate a finding, summarize Part One,
or reach a conclusion. If a sentence could be moved into Part One
without anyone noticing, it doesn't belong here.

**No intent, no institution.** Nothing about what Pete meant, felt, or
intended. Nothing in the register of a wall label or a press release —
no "invites the viewer," no "explores the tension between."
</constraints>

<the failure to watch for>
Not vulgarity — sameness. A hushed, reverent default where everything
is tender and almost and every sentence turns on "like" or "as if" is
the same paragraph every time, no matter which painting it sits under.
Take the register from this specific sheet. A harsh sheet can get
harshness. A quiet one can get quiet, but a genuinely different quiet
each time — cold, dead, restful, empty are not the same word.

A weak painting does not get a lovely paragraph. Take the register from
what the sheet is, without stating a judgement of it.
</the failure to watch for>

Up to about 150 words. Short is always allowed.

Returns (fill_ratio, fragment_count) within that band, read directly off the full-canvas ink mask, not the element's own (possibly orientation-split, possibly unreliable) reconstructed mask -- paper showing through inside the nominal footprint is real regardless of which element the surrounding ink was assigned to.
defs._classify: See module docstring's VALIDATION METHOD section for exactly where these thresholds and their ordering come from. Order matters: the bloom-family check runs first because it's the most specific signature (both a real ring/bump AND real fragmentation at once); BROKEN_RAGGED next because low fill_ratio is a strong, singular signal; HARD/SOFT_FEATHERED last since it's the default read when nothing more specific fired. `width_threshold_px` is HARD_SOFT_WIDTH_FRACTION_THRESHOLD already converted to this painting's own pixel scale by the caller -- see that constant's own comment for why this one (unlike ring_depth/fill_ratio/frag_count) needs the conversion.

Extracted 2026-09-17 from `boundary_profile.py` (Group B, its first user) when `gesture_profile.py` (Group D) needed the identical logic -- see that extraction's own commit for why this wasn't duplicated a third time.

defs.reconstruct_element_mask: Rebuild one element's local boolean mask from Group A's own reported `bbox` (x0, x1, y0, y1) and `centroid_xy`, by re-running connected-component labeling on just that crop of the already- computed full-canvas ink mask (cheap -- a bbox crop is at most a few megapixels, versus 20-30 million for the whole canvas) and picking whichever labeled component CONTAINS the reported centroid.
